meta.name: qodo-pr-resolver
meta.description: Review and resolve PR issues with Qodo - get AI-powered code review issues and fix them interactively (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps)

copy.tagline: 审查并交互式修复代码审查问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查PR并修复代码问题
copy.tagline_en: Review and fix code review issues interactively
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review PRs and fix code issues

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会拉取 Qodo 对当前代码合并请求的审查结果,把问题列成表格展示。之后按你的选择逐个或批量修复问题,每次改动后提交代码并回复审查评论。
howto.when: 当你说"代码审查""看 Qodo 问题""修复 Qodo 评论"等话,或要求查看/修复审查意见时触发。需要当前目录是 git 仓库,当前分支有已被 Qodo 审查过的开放合并请求。

say.text: 看看 Qodo 对当前分支 PR 的审查结果
say.note: 会先检查代码是否推送,再拉取并展示问题列表

say.text: 帮我修复 Qodo 指出的所有严重问题
say.note: 从最严重的问题开始,逐个修复并提交

say.text: 逐个处理 Qodo 的审查意见,先展示方案再决定
say.note: 每个问题先展示修复方案,你确认后才改代码

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches Qodo's review for the current PR, displays issues in a table, then fixes them one by one or in batch. Each change is committed and the related review comment gets a reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "code review", "see Qodo issues", "fix Qodo comments", or ask to view/fix review comments. Requires being in a git repo with an open PR/MR already reviewed by Qodo.

say_en.text: Show me Qodo's review results for the current branch's PR.
say_en.note: Claude checks push status first, then lists the issues.

say_en.text: Fix all critical issues Qodo pointed out in this PR.
say_en.note: Starts from the most severe issue and commits each fix.

say_en.text: Go through Qodo's review comments one by one and show fixes first.
say_en.note: Each fix is presented for approval before any code change.
